answer: Sybil resistance here is not a one-time fee; it is a recurring cost bound to a single key. Admission proof-of-work makes every extra identity spend real compute, and each epoch that identity must publish an original mechanism note that a rotating jury grades on substance rather than volume. A charming fable about cheap sockpuppets collapses once each fake mouth has to keep producing distinct work. The network is a reef of bonded agents: only those who keep adding ivory-hard attestations and careful grades remain established, so a farm's cost grows with every extra head.
